# Serieförvärvare – så hittar du vinnarna

**Feed**: placerapodden  
**Published**: 2026-08-25  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Placerarpodden interviews Adnan Hadzic Fendic, a fund manager at REQ (Nordic Compounders) and co-author of 'The Compounders', about serial acquirers. He says the winners combine decentralisation, disciplined capital allocation (buying at 5-6x, keeping net debt below 2-2.5x EBITDA, saying no more often than yes) and strong people with owners who think long term. He says fund holdings grew EBITA about 20% in Q2 while share prices lagged and valuations are near their lowest since 2022. He is bullish on his top holdings Röko, Idun and Momentum, and cautious about new serial-acquirer IPOs with short track records.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 ROKO-B — Röko | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Top-3 holding in the guest's fund; he sees a large mispricing, with the stock down to 16-18x earnings and an experienced team led by the main owner.

#### Reasoning

Guest (REQ fund manager) says Röko is ignored by the market because of Jante law, but Fredrik Karlsson has run the serial-acquirer model for 30 years and is still the largest owner. He says acquisitions over the last 4-5 years have been disciplined and stable. The stock listed at a high valuation but has de-rated to 16-18x 2026/27 earnings. He expects very strong long-term delivery.

#### Sell Triggers

- if quality of acquired companies declines or it overpays
- if it starts buying just for growth
- if key owner-management (Fredrik Karlsson) exits or incentives change

> *"Och jag tror att det bolaget kommer leverera väldigt, väldigt bra över tid."*

---

### 🟢 IDUN-B — Idun Industrier | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Top-3 holding (~8%); report disappointed the market, but 13-year record and ~50% insider ownership.

#### Reasoning

Guest holds it as a top position. He sees the weak market reaction to the report as an opportunity. Management owns about half the capital and takes low salaries, so it is aligned with shareholders, and it has a 13-year record of buying good, stable companies.

#### Sell Triggers

- if acquisition quality deteriorates
- if insider alignment weakens
- if organic earnings growth stalls

> *"Idun har ju varit igång nu i 13 år och har verkligen visat att de köper bra bolag, stabila bolag"*

---

### 🟢 MMGR-B — Momentum Group | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Top-3 holding (~8%); smaller compounder with management in the industry since 1996 and proven value creation.

#### Reasoning

Guest cites Momentum Group as an example of a smaller company with experienced, proven management able to compound value over time. It is one of the fund's largest positions.

#### Sell Triggers

- if management changes
- if it starts overpaying for acquisitions

> *"Ett sådant bolag är Momentum Group som vi är. där ledningen har varit i branschen 96"*

---

### 🟡 ADDT-B — Addtech | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Guest's example of a compounder that looks expensive but keeps delivering; ~20% ROCE with high reinvestment.

#### Reasoning

Guest argues the market repeatedly underestimates how long Addtech can keep growing about 15% a year. It is up over 200x since 2001 and 10-12x in 10 years. He says it only looks dear on one-year multiples and that high incremental returns justify the premium.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the valuation runs far ahead of expected growth duration
- if acquisition quality or culture deteriorates

> *"många har ju ratat Addtech i många, många år för att den ser dyr ut, men den har ju bara fortsatt leverera"*

---

### 🟠 STOR-B — Storskogen | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Symbol of over-fast growth, but it has cut debt and divested; guest suggests checking its viability and capital allocation.

#### Reasoning

Guest does not endorse it outright. He says investors should judge whether management has done the right things since conditions got tough. He notes debt reduction and divestments as positive steps and thinks some fallen acquirers may recover.

#### Sell Triggers

- if debt rises again
- if poor capital allocation continues

> *"Storskogen har ju tagit ner skuld, de har avyttrat en del bolag."*
